details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:972-1034 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The root hook lacks the worktree-aware implementation and judges pushes or commits from scratch worktrees using the session checkout’s branch.
  WHY: A push from a worktree can be falsely blocked or pass unguarded based on the session checkout rather than the worktree’s destination.

- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:340-345 and lines 348-355 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root hook’s assignment-prefix scan does not recognize append assignments such as `COUNT+=1`, so it can miss guarded Git invocations.
  WHY: Such a push can bypass destination and ancestry evaluation.

- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:249-271 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root hook does not consume shell redirection targets when parsing Git push commands.
  WHY: Redirection tokens can be parsed as refspecs, causing the guard to evaluate the wrong destination.

- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:316-335 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root hook does not preserve the worktree path across `|| exit` command sequences.
  WHY: The push can be judged against the session checkout instead of the worktree, producing a false block.

- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:426-475 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root hook lacks `--repo` remote tracking when selecting positional refspecs.
  WHY: It can discard the actual refspec and check the current branch instead of the requested destination.

- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:465-475 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root hook does not resolve a bare `HEAD` push destination to the target worktree’s current branch.
  WHY: It can check a branch literally named `HEAD` and allow a push to a merged branch.

- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1306-1320 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root hook does not canonicalize source revision expressions to commit SHAs before ancestry checks.
  WHY: Ancestry comparisons can be inaccurate; severity is critical (BLOCKER), though Google rated this MAJOR.

- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py (entire file) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The root and workflow-template copies of the PR merge status guard are not byte-identical.
  WHY: The parity test fails and consumer repos can receive different guard behavior from the source repo.

- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1507-1517 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The root gh-api guard’s literal-ID read-loop exemption differs from the workflow-template copy.
  WHY: The same read loop can prompt in one environment and be allowed in the other.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Keep the workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/ twin byte-identical."
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py and workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The last autofix run modified only workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py; .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py is absent from last_run_changed_files.txt; tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:786-788 requires byte-identical copies; CI reports 5 failed tests.

- requirement: Acceptance: tests in tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py cover all of these: a cd <worktree> && git push origin HEAD:<open-PR branch> from a main checkout sitting on a merged branch is allowed; a push to a merged branch with no open PR is blocked, whatever the main checkout is on; git -C <path> behaves the same way; an unresolvable directory falls back to today's behaviour.
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py and tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: test_worktree_push_to_open_branch_from_merged_checkout, test_worktree_push_to_merged_branch_from_other_checkout, test_git_dash_c_allows_detached_worktree_open_destination, test_unresolvable_worktree_falls_back_to_checkout_with_warning; test_push_parser_guards_real_destination and test_cd_or_exit_preserves_worktree_for_push exercise parser behavior missing from the root hook.

- requirement: "Keep the `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/` twin byte-identical." (linked issue #5144 acceptance criterion; CLAUDE.md §23.H description of the gh-api guard as a source-repo file that `workflow-templates/` keeps byte-identical for consumer delivery via `@stable` sync)

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:972-1034 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The root hook retains the pre-issue implementation and lacks the worktree-aware framework.
  WHY: A push from a scratch worktree can be judged solely by the session checkout’s branch, causing false blocks or allowing an unguarded push.

- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py (entire file, missing functions) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The root hook lacks the parser functions, types, and constants present in the template copy, including redirect handling, `|| exit` preservation, append-assignment matching, `--repo` handling, bare `HEAD` resolution, and source SHA canonicalization.
  WHY: Tests importing the root module require those implementations and fail without them.

- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1507-1517 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The root hook lacks the literal-ID read-loop exemptions present in the template copy.
  WHY: A valid literal-ID read loop prompts in the root hook’s environment but is allowed by the template hook.

- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py (entire file) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The root and workflow-template PR merge status guard copies are not byte-identical.
  WHY: The CI parity test fails, and consumer repos can receive different guard behavior.

- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The root and template gh-api guard copies are not byte-identical; the template has literal-ID read-loop exemptions missing from the root copy.
  WHY: A literal-ID read loop prompts in the root hook but is allowed in the template hook.

- TASK_GAP Requirement: "Keep the workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/ twin byte-identical."
  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py must match workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  Evidence of absence: The last autofix run (commit 01b3618f, last_run_diff.patch) modified workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py with redirect handling, || exit handling, append assignment matching, remote_provided tracking, bare HEAD resolution, and source SHA canonicalization but did not modify .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py. The file is absent from last_run_changed_files.txt. The current root copy retains the pre-issue _evaluate_bash that uses current_branch(cwd) from the session checkout instead of the worktree-aware loop over _guarded_git_invocations. The CI parity test at tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:786-788 fails.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

- TASK_GAP Requirement: "Acceptance: tests in tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py cover all of these: a cd <worktree> && git push origin HEAD:<open-PR branch> from a main checkout sitting on a merged branch is allowed; a push to a merged branch with no open PR is blocked, whatever the main checkout is on; git -C <path> behaves the same way; an unresolvable directory falls back to today's behaviour."
  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py and tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py
  Evidence of absence: The acceptance tests exist in the test file (test_worktree_push_to_open_branch_from_merged_checkout, test_worktree_push_to_merged_branch_from_other_checkout, test_git_dash_c_allows_detached_worktree_open_destination, test_unresolvable_worktree_falls_back_to_checkout_with_warning), but they import the root hook module. Since the root hook lacks the worktree-aware implementation, these tests fail in CI. The test test_push_parser_guards_real_destination exercises commands (git push origin 2>/dev/null, COUNT+=1 git push origin HEAD:feature/x) that require the template copy's redirection handling and append-assignment matching. The test test_cd_or_exit_preserves_worktree_for_push requires the || exit worktree preservation case. The CI log confirms tests-hooks-and-orchestrator: 5 failed, 171 passed.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
